phases.name: Phase 1: Setup
phases.goal: Bind revision 2, preserve the historical attempt, declare bounded resources and observe the first real v2 red before implementing the new controller.
phases.test: Pinned inputs and actual initial bootstrap origin are retained; no v1 artifact is edited or promoted to v2 success.

phases.name: Phase 2: Foundational prerequisites
phases.goal: Build and test v2 records, process/resource control, persistent continuation, source/environment preparation and typed input handling before story execution.
phases.test: A real positive v2 work/attempt run and actual hostile/fault controls pass with complete accounting; interruption preserves a resumable unfinished feature.

phases.name: Phase 3: User Story 1 — Finish justified native execution (P1, first integration milestone)
phases.goal: Deliver working R/GV/original-oracle roles, actual source-to-model correspondence and a whole current quality pass.
phases.test: Fresh B01–B10 type/axiom/kernel and real source/result/authority/encoding controls establish general exactness; independent original replay and the entire unchanged canonical gate pass for the matched subject.

phases.name: Phase 4: User Story 2 — Explain complete cost and test B (P1)
phases.goal: Implement truthful complete-operation attribution and a real same-contract improvement, then finish the full R/GV/B comparison matrix.
phases.test: All five cells ×R/GV/B have three completed timings plus one separate diagnostic, complete original equality, reconciled intervals/work and checked actual B activation/correctness.

phases.name: Phase 5: User Story 3 — Complete lifecycle economics (P1)
phases.goal: Measure fresh establishment, continued work, invalidation/recovery, retention and audit over all real session families/lengths.
phases.test: All three families ×four lengths ×R/GV have three complete timings plus separate diagnostics, original-equivalent continuation and directly observed payback/no-payback with recovery/retention costs.

phases.name: Phase 6: User Story 5 — Build continuation, reproduction and completion machinery (P1)
phases.goal: Implement the positive-capable raw-evidence evaluator, independent reproduction runner and final completion rule; final story acceptance follows US4 and the final integration phase.
phases.test: Real interrupted/corrected work resumes without false completion; actual source/proof/table/context tampering is rejected. The full positive end-to-end test runs after required C evidence exists, not against manufactured completeness flags.

phases.name: Phase 7: User Story 4 — Build and evaluate compact canonical evidence (P2, required)
phases.goal: Implement a real pre-eager-evidence compact path, exact original replay reconstruction, general actual-code proof and full operation/audit comparisons.
phases.test: C preserves the admitted original semantics through proven deltas/identity mappings, rejects missing/corrupt data and false authority, avoids new eager legacy construction at compact completion, and completes all24 timing+8 diagnostic C/L* samples with direct audit totals.

phases.name: Phase 8: Polish and final cross-story integration
phases.goal: Reconcile the final subjects, execute full independent reproduction and finish only from complete working evidence.
phases.test: Every required component, general proof, gate, primary/control/reproduction slot and final consistency check is satisfied; a measured negative cost decision can finish, an unfinished prerequisite cannot.
